subject: Concise security walkthrough: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test kickoff — evening-friendly windows
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finmod.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@finmod.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 / DPA + pen-test walkthrough — availability

Hi Karthik,

FinMod's security team is ready to run a combined intake: SOC 2 scoping, DPA review, and a pen-test kickoff. We prefer a single, compact session (60–90m) rather than multiple handoffs. Our engineering and infosec folks are in Madrid (CET) and Palo Alto (PST) — evening CET / morning PST works best.

Can you propose 2–3 time windows next week that fit Redwood's ops schedule? Also please include a short agenda and a list of documents you'd like us to have ready.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Security Lead, FinMod
security@finmod.com

——
Attachments: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finmod.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@finmod.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA + pen-test walkthrough — availability

Marta —

Thanks — happy to run a single compact intake. Proposed windows (I converted to CET/PST below):

Option A: Tue Nov 18 — 16:00 CET / 07:00 PST (75 min)
Option B: Wed Nov 19 — 18:30 CET / 09:30 PST (90 min)
Option C: Thu Nov 20 — 20:00 CET / 11:00 PST (60 min, tightly focused on DPA + pen kickoff)

Quick agenda (we'll send a formal doc if you want):
- 5m: Introductions and scope confirmation
- 15m: SOC 2 controls outline — what we cover for evidence and timeline
- 15m: DPA / data flow review and key clauses to surface
- 25–40m: Pen-test kickoff — scope, timeline, and staging details
- 5m: Next steps & ownership

I've attached a short proposed agenda and our evidence index so your team can pre-scan what we normally share. If any of the windows are hard, tell me which half-days are blockers and I'll work with Soojin and Olga on ops coverage.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0199

Attachments: proposed-agenda-75min.docx, redwood_evidence_index_v1.pdf
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finmod.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@finmod.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 08:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA + pen-test walkthrough — availability

Karthik —

Thanks for the options. Option B (Wed Nov 19, 18:30 CET / 09:30 PST) looks best for our Madrid and Palo Alto attendees. Question: will the pen-test vendor need separate setup time? Also can you confirm the high-level list of evidence we should pull so we can triage before the call (user access lists, retention config, network diagrams, etc.)?

Tom (copied) is our engineering lead — tagging him for infra questions.

Best,
Marta

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finmod.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, Tom Blake <tom.blake@finmod.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA + pen-test walkthrough — availability

Marta / Tom —

Great — locking Option B (Wed Nov 19, 18:30 CET / 09:30 PST) provisionally. Looping in Soojin (security solutions) and Olga (ops lead) for coverage and to run the evidence review during the call.

To help your triage, here's a short checklist of items to have ready (we'll request copies after the call via our secure file share):
- User access listing for production services (CSV)
- Network diagram (public/private subnets, egress flows)
- Retention and deletion policy snippets (S3 lifecycle, DB TTLs)
- Recent vulnerability scan summary (if available)
- Vendor/subprocessor list referenced in the DPA
- A sample anonymized event log for a 24h window (for staging discussion)

Ops note: We can tighten to 75 minutes if the DPA review is handled asynchronously beforehand. Attached is a compact agenda and an availability-grid.ics — please accept the calendar invite when ready.

If Tom expects the pen-test vendor to join, please introduce them in your next reply and we'll add a 10–15m vendor handoff into the agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Karthik

Attachments: availability-grid.ics, proposed-agenda-75min.docx
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@finmod.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finmod.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 12:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA + pen-test walkthrough — availability

Karthik / team —

Confirmed — we'll have the pen-test vendor (RedProbe) join for a 10–15m handoff at the start of the pen section. I've accepted the provisional slot and attached their point-of-contact in case you need to pre-stage credentials.

RedProbe contact: Jenna Park (jenna.park@redprobe.io)

I'll accept the calendar invite once we have the final invite. See you Wed 18:30 CET.

Tom
Lead Engineer, FinMod
